ml-talk-w-daniel-h.title: ML Talk w Daniel H
ml-talk-w-daniel-h.content:
people
Daniel Hajialigol is my good friend from undergrad. We were in the same major and first met in “Computer Science Foundations for Computational Modeling & Data Analytics”, a class that covered data structures, algorithm performance, high-performance computing, and parallel architectures. He did great in that class and I did not. He’s currently doing a PhD in machine learning at Virginia Tech, while I’m pursuing art; checks out lol.
Now we do a monthly check-in about what’s going on in ML and our lives, a.k.a, Daniel is my PLUG!!
Topics covered this month:

the current edge of locally running AI
“machine unlearning”
distillation
“llm as a judge”
spaCy - create your own labels
Google Gemma models
